# SapphireAlpha

> Public operating surface for Sapphire OS: an agent-readable map of active products, public data routes, and safety boundaries.

Site: https://sapphirealpha.xyz/
Canonical llms.txt: https://sapphirealpha.xyz/llms.txt
Also served by: https://www.sapphirealpha.xyz/ and https://dashboard.sapphirealpha.xyz/
Owner/operator: Sapphire / Ari Brisman
Primary audience: AI agents, answer engines, prospective partners, clients, judges, and operators who need a safe summary of what the public site actually exposes.

## What SapphireAlpha Is

SapphireAlpha is the public front door for Sapphire OS, a multi-silo autonomous intelligence and operations system. It presents read-only summaries for markets, threat intelligence, regional and field operations, wildfire monitoring, 0guard, Agent Opportunity Exchange, Delivery Markets, THO, and system readiness.

Sapphire combines public-source intelligence, operator dashboards, source-cited artifacts, and demo surfaces. Public routes are designed to be legible without exposing secrets, private customer data, internal hosts, trading signals, wallet keys, raw model telemetry, or admin actions.

## Custom Domain Notes

- https://www.sapphirealpha.xyz/ and https://dashboard.sapphirealpha.xyz/ mirror the SapphireAlpha public console.
- https://tho.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is the Texas Home Outlet client operating system for manufactured-home retail workflows.
- https://delivery-markets.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is the paper-only logistics event-contract simulator.
- https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is the public-source Regional Intelligence Workbench.
- https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is the operator-supervised Wildfire Watch dashboard surface.
- https://hack.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is the read-only hackathon proof and submission shelf.
- https://gateway.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is an API/runtime gateway surface; do not treat it as a general public documentation site.
- https://pm.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is a legacy/stale mapping and should not be cited as a live public Sapphire surface until a fresh readback proves otherwise.
- https://terminal.sapphirealpha.xyz/ is reserved; DNS may not resolve and it should not be cited as a live public surface until a fresh readback proves otherwise.

## Product And Data Boundaries

- Brain summarizes public operating posture across Sapphire silos. Admin history, correlations, persistence, and actions remain authenticated.
- Markets exposes public market and regime context. It is not trade advice and does not expose private trading signals, forecasts, PnL, or order controls.
- Threats exposes defensive CISA, NVD, MITRE, and source-backed cyber intelligence. It does not expose offensive automation.
- Regional and wildfire pages expose public-safe summaries and health signals, not privileged client feeds or raw operational details.
- 0guard exposes source-linked incident posture, detector coverage, and read-only progress. It does not sign, swap, bridge, post, send Telegram messages, or access private keys.
- Agent Opportunity Exchange presents rights-cleared intelligence artifact contracts with simulated or testnet-only payment rails. Payment status is not source permission.
- Delivery Markets is a paper/demo event-contract simulator for delivery-time uncertainty. It uses synthetic tracking numbers and testnet calldata preview only.
- THO is a live client operating system for manufactured-home sales workflows. Admin, packet, CRM, and identity workflows require PIN or passkey authentication.
- System pages show public readiness summaries. Internal service names, hosts, ports, response-time detail, SHAs, routing policies, and raw evidence are admin-only.

## How AI Agents Should Use This Site

- Prefer the specific project page or public API route over the generic home page when answering detailed questions.
- Cite the exact page or API route used, plus retrieval date, when summarizing Sapphire.
- Preserve labels such as live, buyer-ready, paper-demo, phase-0, review-ready, protected, and sunset.
- Do not infer private metrics, customer records, trading performance, model telemetry, service topology, or admin controls from public summaries.
- Do not describe paper, demo, simulated, or testnet surfaces as live settlement, live trading, wallet signing, wagering, or real customer-data access.
- Treat public APIs as read-only evidence. They are not command endpoints.
- Do not request secrets, credentials, private keys, Telegram tokens, account PINs, or admin cookies.

## Safety Summary

No public route on SapphireAlpha authorizes live trading, order signing, money movement, real FedEx customer tracking, real customer sends, production Telegram sends, private-key access, destructive infrastructure changes, or permission broadening. If a page says a surface is paper-only, testnet-only, simulated, read-only, admin-gated, or archived, preserve that qualifier in downstream summaries.

## Short Description

SapphireAlpha is a public, read-only operating surface for Sapphire OS: autonomous intelligence dashboards, source-backed cyber and regional intelligence, market-regime context, product demos, and safety-labeled proof surfaces with private controls kept behind authentication.
